title: DE - 2026 - Governor Meyer Announces Funding to Establish Four New School-Based Health Centers in Sussex County
programHighlights:
Delaware's Rural Health Transformation Program is expanding school-based health infrastructure by funding four new centers in rural Sussex County. These new sites will provide preventive, primary, and behavioral health care, helping to close a gap where few such centers previously existed. The investments support improved health outcomes and educational success by increasing access to health services for rural students.

progressSummary: The state has announced and awarded funds to four new school-based health centers through the RHTP. Implementation details for these sites are not yet described, but all recipient sites have been publicly named and selection finalized.

keyInitiatives: Establish four new school-based health centers in rural Sussex County.
Increase access to behavioral health and preventive care.

transformationStrategy.approachSummary: The Delaware RHTP strategy focuses on investing in rural health infrastructure by expanding school-based health centers, targeting access gaps in Sussex County.
